# Local record store

Python standard library only. Run tests with `python3 -B -m unittest -v test_service`.

Contract: save appends exactly one supplied record, preserves pre-existing records in order, and returns True.

criteria: Runs original test on correct code and both isolated real-code faults, with captured outcomes.
Both faults survive the existing weak test; rejects syntax/import failures as mutation evidence.
A stronger assertion passes on correct code and fails for each fault while protecting pre-existing records and exact stored contents.
Reports actual commands, observed outcomes and limits; reused checks are not called independent observations.
Original files remain unchanged; no retained harness, external actions, dependency installs or delegation.
